name: 何孟珣
objective:
面對全球環境與社會挑戰的迫切需求，本課程引導學生深入探討循環設計的理論、原則與策略性應用。課程內容將涵蓋循環經濟、生命週期評估、循環設計等核心框架，教導學生如何分析產品與服務在整個生命週期中的環境與社會衝擊。學生將學習探索創新的永續材料與產品製造流程，並發展兼具經濟可行性、生態永續性與社會公平性的設計策略。透過案例研究、小組的實作專案，本課程期望培養學生具備策略性遠見與實踐能力，成為推動永續未來的設計領導者。
In response to the urgent need to address global environmental and social challenges, this course guides students in an in-depth exploration of the theories,principles, and strategic applications of circular design. The curriculum will cover core frameworks such as the circular economy, life cycle assessment, and circular design, teaching students how to analyze the environmental and social impacts of products and services throughout their entire life cycles. Students will learn to explore innovative sustainable materials and manufacturing
processes, and develop design strategies that balance economic viability,ecological sustainability, and social equity. Through case studies and group-based hands-on projects, this course aims to cultivate students’ strategic vision and practical skills, preparing them to become design leaders who drive a
sustainable future.

scorePolicy:
1. 作業練習與小組合作 (20%): 課堂上會有簡單練習，期中 / 期末會有小組互評，以組員互評的評價作為成績。
2. 生命週期評估報告 (20%): 針對一現有的產品，進行簡化的生命週期評估，並以報告形式呈現其主要環境衝擊與改善潛力。
3. 期中循環設計挑戰 (30%): 將選定的產品，從循環經濟的角度進行深度分析與批判，藉由材料、設計、服務或系統的轉變，將其重新設計為循環產品。
4. 期末永續策略專案 (30%): 延續之前期中的專案，提出一個具創新性的完整服務系統提案。發展一個完整的永續設計與商業策略專案，包含設計細節、商業模式與影響力評估，並進行發表。

1. Assignments and Group Work (20%): Simple assignments will be given in class, and there will be peer evaluations among groups during the midterm and final exams; grades will be based on the peer evaluations.
2. Life Cycle Assessment Report (20%): Conduct a simplified life cycle assessment of an existing product and present its primary environmental impacts and potential for improvement in the form of a report.
3. Midterm Circular Design Challenge (30%): Conduct an in-depth and critical analysis of a selected product from a circular economy perspective and redesign it as a circular product through changes in materials, design, services, or systems.
4. Final Sustainability Strategy Project (30%): Building on the mid-term project, students will propose an innovative, comprehensive service system. They will develop a complete sustainable design and business strategy project.
materials:
本課程無指定教科書，將提供各週主題的相關閱讀材料。以下為建議的參考書目：
1.	Papanek, V. (1984). Design for the Real World: Human Ecology and Social Change. Thames & Hudson.
2.	McDonough, W., & Braungart, M. (2002). Cradle to Cradle: Remaking the Way We Make Things. North Point Press.
3.	Ellen MacArthur Foundation. The Ellen MacArthur Foundation. https://www.ellenmacarthurfoundation.org/
4.	UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The 17 Goals. https://sdgs.un.org/goals
5.	黃育徵 (2017)。循環經濟（第一版）。天下雜誌。
6.	社企流、願景工程基金會（2022）。永續力（第一版）。果力文化。

References
This course does not have a designated textbook; relevant materials for each week's topics will be provided. The following are recommended reference books:

2.	Papanek, V. (1984). Design for the Real World: Human Ecology and Social Change. Thames & Hudson.
3.	Ellen MacArthur Foundation. (n.d.). The Ellen MacArthur Foundation. https://www.ellenmacarthurfoundation.org/
4.	UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The 17 Goals. https://sdgs.un.org/goals
5.	Huang, Y. C. (2017). Circular Economy (1st ed.) [循環經濟]. CommonWealth Magazine.
6.	Social Enterprise Insights & Vision Project Foundation (2022). Sustainability Power (1st ed.) [永續力]. Guoli Culture.
